full_prompt_en: A square graphic anime illustration shows a tall chainsaw-headed figure standing against a vast vivid red sky. The viewpoint is low, so the shoulders and mechanical head rise above the viewer while the lower body is cropped by the frame. The background is almost entirely saturated crimson, with a lighter pink cloud band low on the horizon and faint irregular tonal patches. At the upper center, the figure's head is a dark metal housing with narrow protruding blade-like forms and a small red glowing eye. The underside of the head falls into deep black shadow. A rumpled pale gray-white collared shirt covers the torso, its sleeves rolled to the elbows and its fabric marked by strong diagonal folds. A loose black tie hangs down and curves toward the right, suggesting wind or motion. Dark trousers begin at the waist with a visible belt, then descend into the lower edge. One long dark forearm hangs beside the hip, gripping the handle of a heavy red-brown chainsaw. The machine fills the lower left and center, its toothed blade extending horizontally toward the far left. Dark chain links and mechanical fittings dangle near the right side of the saw. Red light from the sky rims the head, shirt, and metal, while heavier inked shadow defines the arm, trousers, and mechanical recesses. Clean silhouettes and rough scratchy hatch marks work together, leaving the machinery tactile without polishing the image into realism. The bright background contains no setting detail or readable text, isolating the figure as an emblem. The overall composition is stark and ominous, its low-angle posture and limited red, black, and pale gray palette emphasizing danger and raw graphic impact.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形感动画插图呈现一名高大的链锯头人物，站在广阔鲜红天空前。视点很低，肩膀与机械头颅高过观者，下半身被画边截断。背景几乎全是饱和深红，低位地平线附近有一道更浅的粉色云带，并带隐约不规则明度斑。上方中央，人物头部是深色金属外壳，伸出狭窄刀片般结构，一只小红眼发光。头部底面陷入深黑影。一件皱褶浅灰白色翻领衬衫包住躯干，袖子卷到肘部，布料上有强烈斜褶。一条松动黑领带向下垂并向右弯，暗示风或运动。深色裤子从腰带下开始，落入下缘。一条长深色前臂垂在髋旁，握住沉重红棕色链锯的把手。机器填满左下与中央，带齿长刀水平伸向最左侧。深色链条和机械配件垂在锯体右侧附近。红色天光给头、衬衫与金属描边，厚重墨影则界定手臂、长裤与机械凹处。干净剪影和粗糙刮擦排线共同工作，让机器可触，却不把图磨成写实照片。明亮背景没有环境细节或可读文字，使人物像一个徽记般孤立。整体构图严峻而不祥，低角度姿态和受限的红、黑、浅灰配色强调危险与原始图形冲击。
style_prompt_en: The graphic anime image uses a restricted palette of saturated crimson, pink haze, charcoal black, and pale gray. A large nearly flat color field makes a dark central silhouette read immediately, while low-angle placement gives it scale. Strong ink-like contours, scratchy hatching, and rough mechanical textures sharpen the focal object against simpler fabric planes. Red ambient light traces outer edges; large interior black shadows preserve weight and threat. Diagonal folds and one long horizontal accent cut across the otherwise vertical figure. The background stays spare and slightly cloudy, leaving no competing detail. The overall effect is raw, ominous, and poster-like, with extreme color economy and silhouette doing most of the expressive work.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅图形感动画图像使用受限配色：饱和深红、粉色雾、炭黑和浅灰。巨大而近乎平坦的色场让中央深色剪影立即可读，低视点又增加其尺度。强墨线般轮廓、粗糙排线和机械肌理使焦点物从更简洁的布料平面前突出。红色环境光追随外缘，内部大片黑影保留重量与威胁。斜向衣褶和一条长水平重音切过主要竖向形体。背景简洁且稍带云雾，没有争夺注意的细节。整体效果原始、不祥、近似海报，以极端色彩节制和剪影承担多数表现力。
theme_en: A chainsaw-headed figure in a white shirt against a vivid red sky
theme_zh: 鲜红天空前身穿白衬衫的链锯头人物
name: Chainsaw Man
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
